input.body:
Three Claude releases in eight weeks. Opus 4.8 in late May, Fable 5 in June, Opus 5 yesterday.

One project. Three models mid-build. This is the result.

If you swap models mid-build and your output quality changes, the model isn't the problem. The surrounding system is.

When the model sits behind clean interfaces — same quality gates, same evaluation suite, same judge verdicts regardless of which model generated the output — a mid-build swap changes cost and latency. Not quality.

Model choice becomes a routing decision you revisit every release. The architecture stays put.

Shout to Anthropic for shipping three releases in two months.

#buildinpublic
